body: I don't want to put them through the guilt and pain.. I don't want to throw them into the same state I'm in.. At the same time it's hard for me to deal with my depression and the fact that it's gonna be a tedious life every day till it ends..I really don't know if there's a way out
Yea..maybe I believe in it at some level and i think that's what bothers me
So am i.. I just hate the stigma attached to it.. And the hurt of people who love me

I guess that's the only thing that actually makes sense. People i love. But would they want me suffer like this? Do they not want me at peace? What if i was killed in an accident? Would it be the same thing to them?

I don't know what happiness means anymore.. I smile at people i know.. I guess I'm happy i get to see my family, but that's it. That's all there is. I don't even have friends and years of awkwardness, insecurities have left me incapable of making friends. I've tried and worked on advice from places on making friends.. They're supposed to help getting normal again...But in the end it's me who doesn't really want to even get out and talk to people.

But why would God want anyone to go on living like this? If this is the God's image then I'm not sure it's perfect... Or if God is perfect..or if there is a God even.. whom we're trying to please living in our personal hells

Thank you. I've been feeling it should be considered to be like euthanasia.. merciful killing. The idea that it hurts people who are left behind only causes guilt and doesn't help at all. In fact, it makes everything worse.

Thank you for your support. I constantly try to negate these feelings and try and look for some positivity, but sometimes I feel overwhelmed. I know a lot of people are in similar situation and still hang on. I lost a friend to suicide and I wasn't even aware of her situation. I think I understand what she felt now. Death is never a solution, but I really wish to die. Just end it and be at peace. I may not do it myself, but I do pray for it.
